title: Turn fragile-coupling notes into checks
statement: Turn every note in the content that warns of a fragile coupling, such as "must match" or "silently", into an automatic check, since each marks a silent failure.
detail: A red-team skill for the reading course plans found a shipped note saying a string must match the passage sentence character for character or the tap target silently falls back to buttons, and no check enforced it (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/skills/course-red-team/SKILL.md`, rule 15). Such notes sit exactly where a coupling is known to be brittle, so each one is a free specification for a check nobody wrote, guarding a silent failure. The skill's rule is to search note fields for "must match", "character for character", "silently" and "or it will", and turn each into an assertion.

evidence.quote: a free specification for a check nobody wrote, guarding a **silent** failure mode.
Grep note keys for "must match", "character for character", "silently", "or it will", and convert each into an assertion.
